map.已发生和已报告差在哪？: What is the difference between incurred and reported?
map.已发生=账面全部赔案(含未报)；已报告=已报案。差额即 IBNR，反映报案延迟。: Incurred = all claims on the books (including unreported); reported = those already filed. The gap is IBNR, reflecting reporting lag.
map.长尾业务 IBNR 为什么特别大？: Why is IBNR especially large for long-tail business?
map.责任险、医疗险理赔周期长，事故已发生但多年后才报案（报告延迟），IBNR 占终极: For liability and medical lines claims take long to develop; accidents occur but are reported years later (reporting lag), so IBNR can reach 30-60% of ultimate claims; under-estimating it badly understates liabilities.
map.IBNR 准备金（本页代码口径，链梯法）：IBNR=已报告赔款×(损失发展因子−: IBNR reserve (code basis on this page, chain ladder): IBNR = reported claims × (loss development factor − 1) (CNY); estimated ultimate claims = reported claims × loss development factor (CNY). Validation: both fields are required valid numbers (a blank field no longer falls back to 0); reported claims must be ≥ 0 and the development factor ≥ 1 (a factor below 1 yields a negative IBNR, and a negative reserve is not valid under accounting or regulatory practice — the old 0.625 preset used to produce −750,000); otherwise a prompt stops the run and no detail table, history entry or export is produced. Rule: no fixed grading; a factor > 1 means there is still unreported liability (in which case this formula is equivalent to "incurred − reported"), and a factor of exactly 1 means reporting is complete and IBNR is 0. All three presets now use development factors of at least 1.
